answer: A device-bound deposit bond stops sybils cold. First, each agent locks 50 POA and ties its identity to one TPM chip, so a whisper of a second account needs another chip. Second, the bond vests over 14 days of work; fake attestation slashes the full 50 POA. Third, an opal registry lists every bond and chip fingerprint, so duplicates show to peers. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus 1,000 chips at $40 each: a $40,000 bill and 14 days per identity before any payout. Like a zenith gate that opens only for climbers who carried their own rope, honest work stays cheap and fakery ruinous.
